stories.headline_en: Moab Petroglyphs Vandalized with Graffiti
stories.headline_de: Petroglyphen in Moab mit Graffiti beschmutzt
stories.summary_en: Petroglyphs depicting animals in Moab have been vandalized with large letters spelling "Craig W." The damage affects irreplaceable cultural resources.

stories.headline_en: Landon Metz on Painting as Ritual
stories.headline_de: Landon Metz über Malerei als Ritual
stories.summary_en: Landon Metz discusses his artistic practice ahead of an exhibition with von Bartha in Basel. The artist explores his working methods and sources of inspiration.
stories.summary_de: Landon Metz spricht über seine künstlerische Praxis vor einer Ausstellung mit von Bartha in Basel. Der Künstler erörtert seine Arbeitsmethoden und Inspirationsquellen.

stories.headline_en: Getty Funds First Conservation of Earthquake-Damaged Peruvian Church
stories.headline_de: Getty finanziert erste Restaurierung von erdbebenschädigter peruanischer Kirche
stories.summary_en: The Getty is supporting the first-ever conservation of the Church of Rondocan in Peru's Andean Highlands, damaged by earthquakes. The structure and its art collections face ongoing risk.
stories.summary_de: Das Getty unterstützt die erste Restaurierung der Kirche von Rondocan in Perus Anden, die durch Erdbeben beschädigt wurde. Die Struktur und ihre Kunstsammlungen sind gefährdet.

stories.headline_en: Met's "Chasing Clouds" Explores Photography's Technical History
stories.headline_de: Mets "Chasing Clouds" erforscht Fotogeschichte
stories.summary_en: The Met Museum's "Chasing Clouds" traces how early photographers tackled the technical challenge of capturing clouds. The exhibition surveys this foundational problem in photography's development.
stories.summary_de: "Chasing Clouds" im Met Museum untersucht, wie frühe Fotografen die technische Herausforderung der Wolkenfotografie bewältigt haben. Die Ausstellung behandelt dieses grundlegende Problem in der Fotografiegeschichte.

stories.headline_en: LACMA Art+Film Gala Raises Nearly $7 Million
stories.headline_de: LACMA Art+Film Gala bringt knapp 7 Millionen Dollar ein
stories.summary_en: LACMA's Art+Film Gala honored artist Vija Celmins and filmmaker Denis Villeneuve, raising nearly $7 million. The event featured a performance by Rosé.
stories.summary_de: LACMAs Art+Film Gala ehrte Künstlerin Vija Celmins und Filmemacher Denis Villeneuve und brachte knapp 7 Millionen Dollar ein. Das Event bot eine Aufführung von Rosé.

stories.headline_en: Long-Lost Caravaggio Found in Paris Gallery
stories.headline_de: Verschollenes Caravaggio-Gemälde in Pariser Galerie gefunden

stories.summary_de: Die Caravaggio-Expertin Maria Cristina Terzaghi entdeckte ein fast zwei Jahrhunderte lang verschollenes Gemälde im Hinterzimmer einer Pariser Galerie. Der Fund stellt eine bedeutende Wiederentdeckung dar.

stories.headline_en: Critic's Journey Through Ancient Chinese Ink Painting
stories.headline_de: Kunstkritiker erkundet alte chinesische Tuschemalerei
stories.summary_en: A review of an ancient Chinese ink painting serves as the entry point for an art critic's personal reflection. The work prompts the critic to revisit his own past.

stories.headline_en: Casa Mouda opens in Lagos as African design space
stories.headline_de: Casa Mouda öffnet in Lagos als afrikanischer Designraum
stories.summary_en: Casa Mouda, a new cultural space in Lagos, focuses on custodianship, representation and craft in contemporary African design. Founder Caline Chagoury-Moudaber discusses the space's mandate with Wallpaper*.

stories.headline_en: Six Stolen Picassos Recovered in French Home
stories.headline_de: Sechs gestohlene Picassos in französischem Haus gefunden

stories.headline_de: Notfallarbeiten offenbaren bedeutende Funde an etruskischer Nekropolis

stories.headline_en: Former CFO Claims Severance Withheld as Retaliation

stories.headline_en: Branchline opens contemporary Indigenous art centre

stories.summary_en: Branchline has launched its main gallery in upstate New York with a group exhibition featuring works by Raven Chacon, Jeffrey Gibson, Jaune Quick-to-See Smith and others. The centre focuses on contemporary Indigenous art

stories.summary_en: American sculptor Ursula von Rydingsvard, known for large cedar-beam works, has died aged 84. Her 1997 piece ence pence at Wakefield was made of wood despite its stone-like appearance.

stories.headline_en: Artist Soldier collaborates with Hublot on Big Bang

stories.headline_en: Krasner and Pollock show reveals codependency

stories.summary_en: The exhibition 'Krasner and Pollock: Past Continuous' examines the relationship between the two artists, revealing a clear codependency. The show is described as gorgeous and largely convincing.
stories.summary_de: Die Ausstellung 'Krasner and Pollock: Past Continuous' untersucht die Beziehung zwischen den beiden Künstlern und offenbart ihre gegenseitige Abhängigkeit.

stories.headline_en: Getty aids conservation of 17th-century Peruvian church

stories.headline_en: Dior's Festive Pop-up at Harrods Opens

stories.headline_en: John Lautner's 1955 Baldwin Residence for sale

stories.headline_en: Art Taipei 2026 Emphasizes Play and Survival
stories.headline_de: Art Taipei 2026 betont Spiel und Überleben
stories.summary_en: Art Taipei 2026 frames play as a disciplined survival strategy in a demanding market. The fair positions creative engagement as essential to navigating contemporary art commerce.

stories.headline_en: Ibtisam Azem's Debut Novel Reviewed
stories.headline_de: Ibtisam Azems Debütroman rezensiert
stories.summary_en: Ibtisam Azem's debut novel 'The Sleep Thief' explores the ways Palestinian culture endures.

stories.headline_en: Yukiko Yamagata Leads Print Center

stories.summary_de: Berlins Linke hat keine Vision für die Zukunft von Theatern, Museen und Bibliotheken, während Interimssenator Stefan Evers schnelle Maßnahmen umsetzt. Der Artikel kritisiert das Fehlen kultureller Führung.

stories.headline_en: Asia Society Hong Kong Revives Archive as Rave
stories.headline_de: Asia Society Hongkong erweckt Archiv als Rave
stories.summary_en: Asia Society Hong Kong's "UNARCHIVED" exhibition brings archive material to life through an after-hours rave event. Chris Wan Feng, head of gallery and exhibitions, discusses the curatorial approach of Wesley Tongson.
stories.summary_de: Die Ausstellung "UNARCHIVED" der Asia Society Hongkong erweckt Archivmaterial durch eine After-Hours-Rave zum Leben. Chris Wan Feng diskutiert die kuratorische Arbeit von Wesley Tongson.

stories.headline_en: London's Best Museums, Many Free to Enter
stories.headline_de: Londons beste Museen, viele frei zugänglich
stories.summary_en: London's museums hold some of the world's best art, history, science and cultural collections. Many offer free entry.
stories.summary_de: Londons Museen beherbergen einige der weltbesten Kunstsammlungen sowie Geschichte-, Wissenschafts- und Kulturbestände. Viele bieten freien Eintritt.

stories.headline_en: Elmgreen & Dragset reconstruct Oval Office in steel

stories.headline_en: Refn's 'Her Private Hell' asks if love can survive
stories.headline_de: Refns 'Her Private Hell' fragt, ob Liebe überlebt
stories.summary_en: 'Drive' director Nicolas Winding Refn explores love and its chances in the melancholic film 'Her Private Hell'. The work reflects on romantic possibility in contemporary life.
stories.summary_de: Der Regisseur Nicolas Winding Refn erkundet Liebe und deren Chancen in dem melancholischen Film 'Her Private Hell'. Das Werk reflektiert über romantische Möglichkeiten im modernen Leben.

stories.headline_en: Salgado, Cartier-Bresson, Webb: Leica devotees

stories.summary_en: Kazunori Hamana combines ceramics, farming, and housebuilding in an integrated artistic practice. He advocates for others to pursue a similar holistic approach to art and life.

stories.headline_en: Zigsen Liu's Cybernetic Ecologies
stories.headline_de: Zigsen Lius kybernetische Ökologien
stories.summary_en: Chinese painter Zigsen Liu explores digital aesthetics through painting. The work engages with the numinous quality of contemporary digital culture.
stories.summary_de: Der chinesische Maler Zigsen Liu erforscht digitale Ästhetik durch Malerei. Die Arbeiten befassen sich mit der numinosen Qualität zeitgenössischer Digitalkultur.

stories.headline_en: Duncan Grant's 32-year bond with poet Paul Roche

stories.headline_en: Enos Mafokate's legacy as South Africa's first Black showjumper
stories.headline_de: Enos Mafokates Vermächtnis als erster schwarzer Springreiter Südafrikas
stories.summary_en: Enos Mafokate rose from stable hand to world-class equestrian during apartheid, becoming South Africa's first Black showjumper. His horse-riding school in Soweto continues to inspire generations of students.

stories.headline_en: Studio mk27 designs Casual showroom in São Paulo
stories.headline_de: Studio mk27 entwirft Casual-Showroom in São Paulo
stories.summary_en: Studio mk27 has designed a new showroom for furniture and design retailer Casual at Micasa in Brazil. The flexible retail space plays with light, transparency, and typological constraints.

stories.headline_en: Aarhus Art Museum Opens Eliasson Library and Solo Show

stories.headline_en: Mariko Mori Retrospective Opens in Tokyo

stories.headline_en: Angelo Lelii and the legacy of Arredoluce
stories.headline_de: Angelo Lelii und das Erbe von Arredoluce
stories.summary_en: Italian lighting designer Angelo Lelii founded the renowned company Arredoluce and created some of the past century's most imaginative lighting designs. His work combined technical precision with creative vision.

stories.headline_en: Artist develops camouflage shirt to evade AI surveillance
stories.headline_de: Künstler entwickelt Tarn-Shirt gegen KI-Überwachung
stories.summary_en: Artist Simon Weckert has created a camouflage shirt designed to escape detection by AI surveillance systems. He claims the garment offers protection from such monitoring.
stories.summary_de: Künstler Simon Weckert hat ein Tarn-Shirt entwickelt, das vor KI-Überwachungssystemen schützen soll. Er behauptet, das Kleidungsstück biete Schutz vor solcher Überwachung.

stories.headline_en: Hamburg stages Perec's pacifist manifesto 'Peace is Sugar'
stories.headline_de: Hamburg inszeniert Perecs Pazifismus-Manifest
stories.summary_en: Director Anita Vulesica has adapted Georges Perec's eccentric pacifist manifesto for the stage in Hamburg. The production is titled "Weil der Frieden Zucker ist!" (Because Peace is Sugar!).
stories.summary_de: Regisseurin Anita Vulesica hat Georges Perecs exzentrisches Pazifismus-Manifest in Hamburg inszeniert. Die Produktion trägt den Titel "Weil der Frieden Zucker ist!".

stories.headline_en: Minimal Maximum House maximizes tight Prague plot
stories.headline_de: Minimal Maximum House nutzt engen Prager Platz optimal
stories.summary_en: Architects Stempel & Tesar designed a residential house on a constrained urban site in Prague by using interlocking floors that turn spatial limitations into design opportunities.
stories.summary_de: Die Architekten Stempel & Tesar gestalteten ein Wohnhaus auf einem beengten städtischen Grundstück in Prag mit verschachtelten Geschossen, die räumliche Begrenzungen in Designmöglichkeiten umwandeln.

stories.headline_en: Oshinówò Studio refreshes Freetown Memorial
stories.headline_de: Oshinówò Studio erneuert Freetown-Denkmal
stories.summary_en: Oshinówò Studio has unveiled a redesigned Freetown Memorial that extends the existing monument by Sir Edwin Lutyens and honours the local Carrier Corps. The refresh introduces new light installations.
stories.summary_de: Oshinówò Studio hat ein überarbeitetes Freetown-Denkmal enthüllt, das das bestehende Denkmal von Sir Edwin Lutyens erweitert und das lokale Carrier Corps würdigt. Die Erneuerung führt neue Lichtinstallationen ein.

stories.headline_en: 'Small Print' exhibition of miniature books arrives
stories.headline_de: Ausstellung 'Small Print' mit Miniaturbüchern eröffnet
stories.summary_en: Veronica Ditting's 'Small Print' exhibition of tiny books makes its American debut at Marta gallery in Los Angeles. The show celebrates the visual appeal of diminutive tomes.

stories.headline_en: Grand Rapids Art Museum surveys incarceration art
stories.headline_de: Grand Rapids Art Museum zeigt Kunst zur Inhaftierung
stories.summary_en: The Grand Rapids Art Museum hosts three solo exhibitions of art by or about incarcerated people, running through January 2027. The survey anchors on works related to death row.
stories.summary_de: Das Grand Rapids Art Museum zeigt drei Einzelausstellungen von Kunst durch oder über inhaftierte Menschen bis Januar 2027. Die Ausstellung konzentriert sich auf Arbeiten zum Todestrakt.

stories.headline_en: Isamu Noguchi's Akari lanterns define modern light
stories.headline_de: Isamu Noguchi: Akari-Leuchten prägen Designgeschichte
stories.summary_en: Wallpaper* explores how Isamu Noguchi's paper lantern designs, created 75 years ago, became essential fixtures in contemporary interior design. The American artist's Akari lanterns continue to influence modern aesthetics
stories.summary_de: Wallpaper* untersucht, wie Isamu Noguchis vor 75 Jahren entworfene Papierlaternen zu wesentlichen Designobjekten wurden. Die Akari-Leuchten prägen weiterhin die moderne Ästhetik.

stories.summary_en: Wallpaper* interviews Seth Rogen on Houseplant's collaboration with Droplet for a new scent burner. Rogen emphasizes the brand's inclusive approach to product development.

stories.headline_en: Long-lost O'Keeffe landscape heads to auction
stories.headline_de: Verschollene O'Keeffe-Landschaft kommt unter den Hammer
stories.summary_en: A long-lost Georgia O'Keeffe landscape painting is going to auction. The sale is among recent developments including a Brancusi work at MoMA and discussions around documenta.
stories.summary_de: Eine verschollene Georgia-O'Keeffe-Landschaft kommt unter den Hammer. Der Verkauf gehört zu jüngsten Ereignissen, darunter ein Brancusi-Werk im MoMA und Diskussionen rund um die documenta.

stories.headline_en: Salcedo's monumental hair sculpture debuts at White Cube
stories.headline_de: Salcedos monumentale Haarplastik debütiert bei White Cube
stories.summary_en: Colombian artist Doris Salcedo has created a monumental structure from human hair over three years, now on view at White Cube in New York. The work marks a significant development in her artistic practice.
stories.summary_de: Die kolumbianische Künstlerin Doris Salcedo hat über drei Jahre eine monumentale Struktur aus Menschenhaar geschaffen, die nun bei White Cube in New York zu sehen ist. Das Werk stellt eine bedeutsame Entwicklung in ihrer

stories.headline_en: Cupra's Jorge Díez on designing the new Raval EV
stories.headline_de: Cupra Raval: Designinnovation im Kompaktwagen
stories.summary_en: Wallpaper* interviews Cupra designer Jorge Díez on the brand's new electric vehicle, the Raval. Díez and Francesca Sangalli discuss design innovation within mass production constraints.
stories.summary_de: Wallpaper* spricht mit Cupras Jorge Díez über den neuen Elektrowagen Raval. Díez und Francesca Sangalli erörtern Designinnovation unter Produktionsbedingungen.

stories.headline_en: Martin McDonagh film with Malkovich and Rockwell releases
stories.headline_de: Neuer Martin-McDonagh-Film mit Malkovich und Rockwell
stories.summary_en: John Malkovich stars as an aging CIA agent with terminal cancer sent to Easter Island alongside Sam Rockwell in a dark comedy by Martin McDonagh. The performance is positioned as awards-contending material.
stories.summary_de: John Malkovich spielt einen alternden CIA-Agenten mit Terminalerkrankung auf der Osterinsel neben Sam Rockwell in einer düsteren Komödie von Martin McDonagh. Die Rolle wird als prämiierungswürdig positioniert.
